calculators.name: TAM / SAM / SOM Market Sizing Calculator
calculators.description: Calculates Total Addressable Market (TAM), Serviceable Addressable Market (SAM), and Serviceable Obtainable Market (SOM) using top-down and bottom-up market sizing methodologies.
calculators.formula_text: TAM = Total Target Customers in World/Region × Average Annual Contract Value (ACV); SAM = Target Customers within Reachable Segment/Geography × ACV; SOM = SAM × Realistic Market Share % (typically 1-5% within 1-3 years).

inputs.label: Total Potential Customers in Market (Global or Primary Territory)
inputs.description: Total universe of individuals or companies experiencing the problem your solution solves.

inputs.label: Average Annual Revenue per Customer (ACV / ARPU)
inputs.description: Expected annual spend per account or subscriber.

inputs.label: Serviceable Market Filter % (Geography, Channel, Tech Stack Fit)
inputs.description: Portion of the total market that matches your specific niche, geography, and sales channel capability.

inputs.label: Target Obtainable Market Share % (Years 1-3)
inputs.description: The realistic percentage of your SAM you can capture within 24 to 36 months given current resources.

outputs.label: Total Addressable Market (TAM)
outputs.description: Overall revenue opportunity if you achieved 100% market share of all potential buyers.

outputs.label: Serviceable Addressable Market (SAM)
outputs.description: Target segment of the TAM within your geographic, linguistic, or regulatory reach.

outputs.label: Serviceable Obtainable Market (SOM)
outputs.description: Realistic near-term revenue goal representing defensible target market share.

outputs.label: Required Paying Customers to Hit SOM
outputs.description: Actual number of closed deals or subscribers needed to hit the SOM objective.

example_calculation.scenario: B2B Accounting Automation for Dental Clinics in the US

seo.title: TAM SAM SOM Calculator — Free Market Sizing Tool for Startups
seo.description: Calculate Total Addressable Market (TAM), Serviceable Addressable Market (SAM), and Obtainable Market (SOM) with real formulas and benchmark ranges.

calculators.name: Burn Rate & Runway Calculator
calculators.description: Projects cash exhaustion timeline, net monthly burn, and zero-cash date based on current cash reserves, gross expenses, and monthly revenue growth.
calculators.formula_text: Net Monthly Burn = Gross Monthly Expenses - Monthly Recurring Revenue; Cash Runway (Months) = Current Cash Balance / Net Monthly Burn; Zero-Cash Date = Current Date + (Runway × 30.4 days).

inputs.label: Current Cash & Liquid Reserves
inputs.description: Total available bank balance dedicated to operations.

inputs.label: Gross Monthly Operating Expenses (Payroll, Servers, Tools, Rent)
inputs.description: Total cash out the door every 30 days.

inputs.label: Monthly Inflowing Cash / Revenue
inputs.description: Current monthly collected revenue.

inputs.label: Expected Monthly Revenue Growth Rate %
inputs.description: Compound monthly percentage increase in monthly revenue.

outputs.label: Initial Net Monthly Burn
outputs.description: Net cash loss incurred per month before taking into account growth compounding.

outputs.label: Estimated Runway (Months)
outputs.description: Number of months the business can survive without new financing or inflection.

outputs.label: Safe Next Round Kickoff Window
outputs.description: You must begin fundraising or launch aggressive cost cuts at least 6 months before zero cash.

outputs.label: Default Alive / Default Dead Assessment
outputs.formula_expression: if (monthly_revenue_growth_rate > 0 and compounding_revenue >= gross_monthly_expenses before cash_balance <= 0) then 'Default Alive' else 'Default Dead'
outputs.description: Paul Graham definition: whether current growth reaches profitability before bank balance reaches $0.

industry_benchmarks.series_a_readiness: 12 - 18 months runway remaining when initiating investor pitch cycles
industry_benchmarks.bootstrapped_lifestyle: 3 - 6 months personal runway reserve + cash-flow positive operations

seo.title: Startup Runway & Burn Rate Calculator — Calculate Zero-Cash Date
seo.description: Track your gross burn, net burn, and startup runway in months. Plan fundraising timing with dynamic growth modeling.

calculators.name: Break-Even Analysis Calculator
calculators.description: Calculates the exact sales volume in units and total revenue required to cover all fixed and variable costs, leaving zero net profit or loss.
calculators.formula_text: Contribution Margin per Unit = Unit Sales Price - Variable Cost per Unit; Contribution Margin Ratio = Contribution Margin per Unit / Unit Sales Price; Break-Even Volume (Units) = Fixed Operating Costs / Contribution Margin per Unit; Break-Even Revenue = Break-Even Volume × Unit Sales Price.

inputs.label: Total Monthly Fixed Operating Costs
inputs.description: Overhead expenses paid regardless of production volume: salaries, rent, software subscriptions, insurance.

inputs.label: Sales Price per Unit (or Subscription Price)
inputs.description: Average selling price for one unit or one month of service.

inputs.label: Variable Cost per Unit (COGS, Shipping, Payment Fees)
inputs.description: Direct incremental expenses incurred per unit sold: payment gateway percentage, hosting per user, raw materials, packaging.

outputs.label: Contribution Margin per Unit
outputs.description: Dollar amount each sale contributes toward paying down fixed monthly overhead.

outputs.label: Contribution Margin Ratio
outputs.description: Percentage of every revenue dollar available to cover fixed costs.

outputs.label: Break-Even Sales Volume (Units)
outputs.description: Number of sales needed each month to achieve exact zero profit/loss.

outputs.label: Break-Even Revenue ($)
outputs.description: Total monthly revenue required to achieve profitability.

industry_benchmarks.saas_software: 75% - 88% contribution margin ratio (break-even reached at low unit volume)
industry_benchmarks.ecommerce_dtc: 35% - 55% contribution margin ratio (sensitive to ad spend and shipping)
industry_benchmarks.agency_consulting: 50% - 70% gross contribution margin ratio after contractor hours

seo.title: Break-Even Calculator — Calculate Units & Revenue to Break Even
seo.description: Determine your break-even point in units and sales dollars with fixed overhead, variable costs, and contribution margin ratios.

calculators.name: Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & Payback Calculator
calculators.description: Calculates fully blended Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), paid-only CAC, and CAC payback period in months.
calculators.formula_text: Blended CAC = (Total Ad Spend + Sales Salaries + Marketing Software) / Total New Customers Acquired; CAC Payback Period (Months) = Blended CAC / (Average Monthly Revenue per Customer × Gross Margin %).

inputs.label: Total Paid Advertising Spend (Meta, Google, LinkedIn)
inputs.description: Direct media spend allocated to paid campaigns.

inputs.label: Sales & Marketing Team Headcount Cost
inputs.description: Salaries, contractor fees, and commissions directly associated with acquiring customers.

inputs.label: Marketing Tooling & Software Stack
inputs.description: Cost of CRM, email automation, analytics, and landing page hosting.

inputs.label: Total New Paying Customers Acquired in Period
inputs.description: Total count of closed accounts during the measurement window.

inputs.label: Average Monthly Revenue per User (ARPU)
inputs.description: Expected monthly gross billings per customer.

inputs.label: Gross Margin Percentage %
inputs.description: Gross margin after server, hosting, or direct fulfillment costs.

outputs.label: Fully Loaded Blended CAC
outputs.description: Comprehensive cost to acquire one paying customer including all overhead and team expenses.

outputs.label: Paid Media CAC (Direct Ad Only)
outputs.description: Direct media efficiency before headcount allocation.

outputs.label: CAC Payback Period (Months)
outputs.description: Time in months before gross profit from an acquired customer repays the capital spent to acquire them.

seo.title: Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & Payback Calculator
seo.description: Calculate fully loaded CAC, paid media CAC, and payback period in months to measure acquisition efficiency.

calculators.name: Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) & LTV:CAC Ratio Calculator
calculators.description: Calculates Customer Lifetime Value (LTV), average customer lifespan, and the golden LTV:CAC ratio to determine unit economics sustainability.
calculators.formula_text: Average Lifespan (Months) = 1 / (Monthly Churn Rate % / 100); Gross Customer Lifetime Value = (Average Monthly Revenue per Account × Average Lifespan) × (Gross Margin % / 100); LTV:CAC Ratio = LTV / Blended CAC.

inputs.label: Average Monthly Revenue per User (ARPU / AOV)
inputs.description: Average gross monthly billing per account.

inputs.label: Monthly Customer Churn Rate %
inputs.description: Percentage of existing subscribers that cancel subscription each month.

inputs.label: Gross Margin Percentage %
inputs.description: Gross margin after direct fulfillment and hosting costs.

inputs.label: Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
inputs.description: Total marketing and sales expense spent to acquire one customer.

outputs.label: Expected Customer Lifespan
outputs.description: Average duration in months a subscriber remains active before churning.

outputs.label: Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)
outputs.description: Total gross profit an individual customer generates over their entire tenure.

outputs.label: LTV to CAC Ratio
outputs.description: Return multiplier on customer acquisition investment. Benchmark standard is ≥ 3.0x.

outputs.label: Unit Economics Health Verdict
outputs.formula_expression: if (ltv_cac_ratio < 1.0) then 'Value Destroying' else if (ltv_cac_ratio < 3.0) then 'Marginal / High Burn' else if (ltv_cac_ratio <= 5.0) then 'Healthy & Sustainable' else 'Underinvesting in Growth'
outputs.description: Benchmark verdict guiding growth capital allocation.

industry_benchmarks.sub_1x: Losing money on every acquired user (critical emergency)
industry_benchmarks.1x_to_3x: Acceptable for early testing, but fragile to CAC spikes
industry_benchmarks.3x_to_5x: Venture-backable sweet spot with high capital efficiency
industry_benchmarks.greater_than_5x: Opportunity to bid more aggressively to capture market share

example_calculation.scenario: Vertical SaaS for Architectural Design Studios
